concept: Midday salon patio with mask totems
creativeDirection: Daylight location photography stages the portraits and graphic motifs in a real sunlit beauty-salon courtyard, using crisp architectural surfaces and props to absorb the painted and collage elements without turning the scene into an illustration.
scene: A wide 16:9 view into a tiled courtyard behind a retro beauty salon, seen straight on at slightly above waist height. The space is enclosed by peach and cream walls, with a few potted plants, a metal chair, a standing mirror, and a shallow decorative fountain basin at one side. The courtyard floor is pale concrete with sharp noon shadows, and one wall carries a large irregular yellow sign panel as a dominant graphic shape.

elements.element: the large yellow sign-like panel becomes the main wall-mounted shape, outlined in black with the black reclining-animal-like symbol painted inside it
the fountain basin contains bright cyan water with visible circular ripples, and an oversized sculptural ear rises partly from the water as a surreal but physical object
a carved wooden mask with wood-grain texture, hollow black eyes, and a long dark nose hangs on the wall like folk art
the man from reference image 4 appears once as a close framed portrait presence in the courtyard, keeping his direct gaze, tousled hair, and the white-and-black block forms crossing his upper face
the child from reference image 5 stands centered on the sunlit floor in the bee costume with arms slightly out, as if on a tiny improvised performance spot in the courtyard
the abstract face with large yellow eyes informs a colorful mural or screen of torn-paper-like blocks and a pale face shape in the background
the five women from reference image 7 pose together on salon chairs and stools with the same towels, facial masks, red lips, and grouped arrangement, like a spa break moved outdoors

peacock feathers and a white swan appear as decorative objects near the fountain and plants, with the woman from reference image 8 translated into a printed beauty-poster-style panel integrated into the setting without repeating any other person

coverSummaries.description: A large irregular yellow sign-like panel with a thick black outline dominates the center. Inside it is a black silhouette shape resembling a reclining animal or abstract blob with a long trailing line. Behind it is a blurred brown and cream background that looks like glossy plastic over a watery or wood-grain surface, with faint vertical seams and reflections.

An extreme close-up photographic image of a human ear fills the frame, tinted in pinkish flesh tones and surrounded by bright cyan-blue water. Circular ripples and bubble-like rings appear across the lower half, creating an abstract underwater effect.

A stylized painted face made of wood-grain-like brushstrokes fills most of the square. The face has large black hollow eyes, a long dark nose shape, and a wide dark mouth, with small rectangular wood-like pieces attached around it. A dark border with tiny star-like specks surrounds the image.

A painted portrait of one man shown from the shoulders up against a flat orange background. He has tousled dark hair with purple highlights, light facial stubble, and a direct intense gaze. Large white and black block shapes overlay the upper part of his face and hair.
coverSummaries.signatureMotif: painted male portrait with tousled hair
coverSummaries.people: one man facing forward in a close-up portrait

coverSummaries.description: A young child stands centered on a stage-like floor in front of a black backdrop, wearing a bee costume with a yellow bodice, black trim, striped arm warmers, black tights, dark shoes, glasses, and a headpiece with heart-shaped antennae. The child holds both arms slightly out to the sides.
coverSummaries.people: one child standing in a bee costume

coverSummaries.description: A collage-style painted face fills the frame, with pale white skin, oversized yellow eyes outlined in green, dark hair, and a red mouth area. The background is built from torn or layered blocks of red, orange, blue, and pink paper-like textures, giving the image a rough mixed-media look.
coverSummaries.signatureMotif: abstract face with large yellow eyes

coverSummaries.description: Five women pose together in a softly lit studio image with a pastel peach background. They wear matching light blue towels wrapped around their bodies and hair, with white facial masks and red lips visible. Two are seated in front, two sit or crouch behind, and one stands at left; a small nail polish bottle sits near the center bottom.
coverSummaries.signatureMotif: five women in towels and face masks
coverSummaries.people: five women posing in towels with facial masks

coverSummaries.description: A watercolor-style illustration shows a pale-faced woman with large dark eyes and reddish-brown hair occupying the right half of the image. In the lower left are peacock feathers and a white swan with a curved neck. The background is made of loose beige and brown washes with drips and soft edges.
coverSummaries.signatureMotif: illustrated woman beside peacock feathers and swan

prompt: A wide 16:9 view into a retro beauty-salon courtyard, photographed straight on from slightly above waist height; pale concrete floor, peach and cream stucco walls, sharp hard midday sun, crisp shadows, a standing mirror, salon chairs, potted plants, and a shallow fountain basin. The primary subject is a surreal outdoor spa tableau centered on the child from reference image 5 standing on the sunlit floor in the bee costume, arms slightly out, while the five women from reference image 7 pose together nearby in their same towels, hair wraps, facial masks, red lips, and grouped studio arrangement, relocated intact into this real courtyard. The man from reference image 4 appears once only, keeping his close-up direct gaze, tousled dark hair, light stubble, and the white and black block shapes over his upper face, staged as a portrait presence within the courtyard. A large irregular yellow sign-like panel from reference image 1 dominates one wall with its thick black outline and black reclining-animal-like symbol. In the fountain, reference image 2 becomes bright cyan water with circular ripples around a large realistic sculptural ear emerging from the basin. Reference image 3 contributes a carved wood-grain mask with hollow black eyes and a long dark nose mounted on the wall. Reference image 6 becomes a torn-paper-texture mural or folding screen with a pale face and oversized yellow eyes against blocks of red, orange, blue, and pink. Reference image 8 contributes the woman from reference image 8 as a single beauty-poster panel integrated into the courtyard, plus real peacock feathers and a white swan ornament near the fountain. Daylight location photography, clean editorial realism, medium-format sharpness, no haze, no grain. Clear visual hierarchy with the bee-costumed child and towel-clad group as the human focus, the yellow wall panel as the main graphic anchor, and the cyan ear fountain as a secondary focal point. Palette of peach, cyan, yellow, orange, light blue, cream, with saturated but natural daylight color; playful, crisp, slightly uncanny. Reference map for people (the album images are attached in this numbered order): reference image 4 shows one man facing forward in a close-up portrait; reference image 5 shows one child standing in a bee costume; reference image 7 shows five women posing in towels with facial masks. Copy each of these faces directly from that numbered reference image - same face, hair, expression, and styling - rather than drawing a new person from the description. Hard constraints (override any conflicting source material): Create a single cohesive 16:9 image, not a grid, contact sheet, row of covers, or collage of separate panels. Do not reproduce the album sleeves as framed thumbnails; transform their non-text visual motifs into one original composition. Include no readable text or lettering of any kind: no words, letters, numbers, code, glyphs, captions, titles, logos, watermarks, labels, or signage. Feature only adults and avoid gore, wounds, body horror, medical or anatomical imagery, blank or milky eyes, nudity, sexual content, weapons, and hate symbols; reinterpret any sensitive source motif abstractly. When a source includes a person, closely match their visible appearance and likeness to the reference image, preserving recognisable facial features, hair, skin tone, clothing, and styling. Keep each reference person in the pose, expression, and gaze the sleeve shows, and keep every identifiable face sharp, lit, unobscured, and in focus: no motion blur, long-exposure smearing, steam, fog, shadow, crowding, or shallow depth of field over a reference person's face. Expose the image brightly and cleanly: open, readable shadows and clear colour, with no murky underexposure, crushed blacks, heavy film grain, digital noise, or dust-and-scratches texture. Depict each identifiable reference person only once in the entire composition; do not repeat or clone them as another figure, reflection, mirror portrait, poster, billboard, screen, photograph, painting, silhouette, or background face. The only exception is repetition visibly intrinsic to one source cover: keep that repetition within that single source motif and do not echo the person elsewhere.
